premises.text: Privacy regulation and fines make getting data access for AI slow because data is locked or must pass privacy engineering, legal, and security reviews
premises.evidence_span: data privacy to be the biggest challenge for companies to build AI software today. We have spoken to hundreds of data and AI teams located in AI startups, enterprises like banks and insurance, and governments, and they all face the same problem. It takes a long time to get access to data

premises.text: BetterData converts private real data into fully anonymized synthetic data with the same properties for analytics and ML
premises.evidence_span: We convert private real data into 100% anonymized synthetic data that has the same properties as the real data

premises.text: Confidential computing lets jobs run on encrypted data so BetterData cannot see customer data
premises.evidence_span: We introduced confidential computing, where you can compute on encrypted data, so companies don't have to trust us with data because we can't even see it

premises.text: Data tokenization with tamper-proof locks keeps companies as full owners of their data tokens
premises.evidence_span: data tokenization. Companies own their data fully, and we have tamper-proof locks for that as well

premises.text: Encrypted multi-party collaboration produces combined synthetic datasets without plaintext sharing between parties
premises.evidence_span: companies can collaborate on data sets together and understand more about their combined and common customers, all while the data remains encrypted for all parties involved

premises.text: Each synthetic dataset ships with a QA report showing ML performance comparable to models trained on real data
premises.evidence_span: Every single synthetic data we produce comes with a quality assurance report. And this ensures that synthetic data can be used just like the real data for your analytics, for your machine learning

premises.text: Licensing and support model covers on-premise, private, and public cloud via APIs or web UI
premises.evidence_span: We have a licensing and support business model, and we support on-premise, private, and public cloud

premises.text: Close work with regulators ensures synthetic data is privacy-safe to use
premises.evidence_span: we work very closely with regulators to ensure that our synthetic data is privacy safe to use
